senses.gloss: कुक् augment क् (1) added to ङ् at the end of a word before a sibi- lant letter; e.g प्राङ्क्शेते cf. P.VIII. 3.28; (2) added to the words वात and अतीसार before the affix इन्, cf. P.V.2.129; (3) added to words of the नड group before the tad. affix छ (ईय), e.g. नडकीयम्, प्लक्षकीयम् cf. P.IV.2.91.
